listDelegation.description: Open the domain-wide delegation page in a FOREGROUND tab (a re-auth passkey challenge may appear; only a human at the machine can pass it) and wait up to ~4 minutes, polling every 10s, for the URL to settle on domainwidedelegation rather than an accounts.google.com challenge. Returns the delegation rows once the page is ready, or a reauth stop if it never settles.

returns.description: {targetId, rows:[{name, clientId, scopes}]} on success; {stop:"reauth-required", hint} if the passkey prompt never clears

deleteDelegation.description: WRITE, revokes an integration. Refuses unless confirm:true. Real-clicks the Delete leaf in the row matching clientId, then the Delete button in the confirm dialog, then re-reads the table to verify the row is actually gone -- a synthetic click reporting success proves nothing on this page.

clientId.description: 21-digit OAuth client id identifying the row

confirm.description: must be true; a human has decided to revoke this delegation

returns.description: {deleted: true} once re-reading the rows confirms clientId is no longer listed; {stop:"still-listed"} or another stop reason otherwise
